contract: With zeta(n)=indicator(n>=N), the stated Assumption 3 must justify zero coefficients after N before the 2T tail term can be removed and sqrt(NT) concluded.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: A coefficient sequence satisfies literal Assumption 3 but has nonzero tail, and the prescribed N-dimensional OT optimizer has linear true regret.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: The implication and rate are proved over the literal premise.
